title: The Escape View Trap
goal: Return formatted text from a function without holding references to local variables.
hints: to_uppercase creates a brand new owned String on the stack inside get_prefix.
Returning a view &str into a local String leaves a dangling pointer when the function returns.
explanation: s.trim().to_uppercase() creates a new owned String on the function's stack frame. Returning &uppercase[..4] attempts to hand back a borrowed view into memory that will be dropped at the end of the function, triggering E0515. To return data that outlives the local scope, the function must transfer ownership of a new String using uppercase[..4].to_string().
